heading.title: Incorporation of Company and Matters Incidental Thereto

article.title: Authentication of documents, proceedings and contracts.
article.content:
21Authentication of documents, proceedings and contracts.

Section 21  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 38 of the Act
Save as otherwise provided in this Act,—
(a) a document or proceeding requiring authentication by a company; or
(b) contracts made by or on behalf of a company, may be signed by any key managerial personnel or 1[an officer or employee of the company] duly authorised by the Board in this behalf.
1 Subs. by Act 1 of 2018, s. 7, for “an officer of the company” (w.e.f. 9-2-2018).
